description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kivuleyaya, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720007 (23/1056)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration particulars. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
